description: We are a passionate and ambitious team of innovators, problem-solvers, and space enthusiasts coming together to take on the NASA Space Apps Challenge. Our goal is to transform ideas into meaningful solutions by combining creativity, technology, science, and teamwork. We believe that curiosity drives innovation, collaboration makes great things possible, and even the biggest challenges can be solved with the right mindset. Together, we are ready to explore new possibilities
summary:
Our project is an interactive space exploration website designed to bring the stories of humanity's greatest space missions closer to everyone.

Visitors can explore missions, follow spacecraft trajectories, and discover how historic journeys, such as Apollo's mission to the Moon, unfolded. Through interactive 3D models, they can examine spacecraft and rovers, discover their different parts, and learn about the technology that makes space exploration possible.

One of the website's main features is an interactive rover simulator, where users can control a virtual rover, move it across the terrain, and turn it in different directions. This gives visitors a simple way to experience what it is like to operate a robotic explorer on another world.

By combining interactive maps, 3D exploration, simulations, and mission storytelling, we aim to make space science more engaging and easier to understand.

We created this project because we believe exploring space should not be limited to scientists. Everyone should have the opportunity to discover, learn, and feel part of humanity's journey beyond Earth.
details:
Our project is an interactive space exploration platform that makes learning about space missions more engaging and accessible.

The website allows visitors to explore real space missions through interactive maps, spacecraft trajectories, mission stories, and 3D models. Users can follow the journeys of spacecraft, including historic missions such as Apollo, and discover the technology and engineering behind humanity's exploration of space.

A key feature is our interactive rover simulator, where visitors can control a virtual rover by moving and turning it across a simulated surface. This gives users a simple way to experience how robotic exploration works and understand some of the challenges of controlling machines on other planets.

We wanted to create something more engaging than a traditional educational website. By combining storytelling, interactive elements, 3D visualization, and simulation, we turn space exploration into an experience where users can actively discover and learn.

The website was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with AI-assisted development and debugging. We also used NASA resources and mission information to support the educational content.

Our intended impact is to inspire curiosity about science, technology, engineering, and space exploration, especially among younger audiences. We hope our project helps people understand that space exploration is not just about reaching distant worlds, but also about the creativity, teamwork, and discoveries that make it possible.
